name: cooling_ceiling_simplified
title: Simplified cooling ceiling (sizing and TXV control)
summary: Simplified cooling-ceiling model: the nominal water capacity rate and conductance are sized from the nominal cooling load, and the heat rate is the effectiveness times the capacity rate times the supply-to-air temperature difference, multiplied by a valve factor linear in the air-temperature offset.

origin.course: ULiège model bank, simplified cooling ceiling with sizing and TXV control, 2008-03-17
